$status: A Codex approved by Hugh 29 Oct 2026. Follows the Brand Codex from 4 Nov 2026 (Decision - Grimoiria follows the Brand Codex).
$source: The Brand Codex (Hugh's Master Brand Style), pack hughtran, pinned in Design/codex/tokens.json. Palette entries name a Codex role; edit this map, never the outputs, then run tools/gen-tokens.py.
$palette: codex = a Codex role (pack.color.role, mode day or night). legacy = not in the Codex; kept so this change is invisible, replaced by the Codex night (mutation 3) or retired with styles B and C (mutation 4). app = an app-only shade for Material container slots.

ink.use: text and marks on light grounds

soot.use: dark ground (style C only now; retired in mutation 4)

vellum.use: raised panels on the paper page (the Codex calls it surface)

linen.use: text on dark and night grounds

rubric.use: marks, rules, illustration. The only thing that glows.

rubricSmall.use: red text under 24 pt on light grounds

rubricOnDark.use: red on dark and night grounds

beltaneDeep.use: night surface, one step under the ground

nightInk.use: text and lines at night (warm paper white)

nightRed.use: marks and glow at night: the red turns green

nightRubric.use: red text at night: the rubric turns green

nightPanel2.use: Pixel: surface container high at night (the Codex's raised forest panel)

nightLine.use: Pixel: surface container highest at night (the Codex's forest hairline tone)

glyph.note: Hugh's own typeface for astrological glyphs. Not bundled yet.

type.$note: Points. Garamonds sit small on screen, so text runs about 2 pt over Apple's sizes.

system.name: System
system.summary: Apple's look with your accent. Today's app.

a.name: A · Codex
a.summary: Full press. Paper page by day, forest night after dark, Garamond everywhere, square corners, red only for marks (green at night).
a.$light: Brand Codex day: paper page, surface panels, hairlines at 25% ink (mutation 2, 4 Nov 2026).
a.$dark: Brand Codex night: forest ground, warm ink, every red turns green (mutation 3, 4 Nov 2026).

b.name: B · Marginalia
b.summary: Light touch. Apple's pages and labels, Garamond for titles and your writing, rubric accent.

c.name: C · Beltane Night
c.summary: Night ground in Beltane ultramarine, linen type, red that glows. Always dark.
